item.title: MagSafe Monday: LISEN’s 3-in-1 Qi2 charger is designed to handle all of your devices with unique a foldable design
item.description: LISEN has been one of my favorite recent brands that I’ve been watching. The company’s new 3-in-1 charger is a really nice addition to its lineup. One of the things I love most about it is the foldable design, which is somewhat unique for most MagSafe charging setups. It can charge your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch, and also includes Qi2 support. I have a new office setup, this is the one I am using next to my laptop. more…
